The '''Mygeeto system''' was located in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. The [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Mygeeto/Legends|Mygeeto]] drew the [[InterGalactic Banking Clan/Legends|InterGalactic Banking Clan]] because of its industrial areas and opportunities for them to maintain their own industrial plants.
